name: Wind Ward
description:
Concentration, up to 1 minute.

You create swirling winds out to short range. Distribute five +1 Defense bonuses among creatures within range as you choose. Check a Condition.

When a creature with a bonus is hit by a melee or ranged attack, you may check another Condition to maintain that bonus; otherwise, that creature loses it.

On your turn, you may spend a half action to redistribute any remaining bonuses among creatures within range.

Describe how you protect your allies.
